messages:
amy: Heads-up: saw customers report partner keys being charged for calls that should have been billed to exchanged SAs. noticed after last week's auth-proxy rollout.

ben: saw similar in billing alerts. looks like attribution falls back to incoming API key before async exchange finishes.

serena: tracing shows token_exchange span often finishes ~30-80ms after router decision. router attributes immediately if X-Effective-Principal header absent.

console-team: UX hit: CS gets tickets with 'why was partner key billed?'. we should surface an "attribution_reason" column in request logs (exchange|fallback|cache) + an "effective_identity" field collapsed by default. admin-only.

amy: short-term mitigation idea: router consults a tiny exchange-cache and waits up to 80ms if an exchange is pending for that key_id. keep behind feature flag `auth.attribution.wait_for_exchange`.

ben: +1. implement metrics: auth.attribution.waited_count, auth.attribution.fallback_count, auth.attribution.wait_ms. add alert if waited_count causes p50 latency regressions >1%.

infra-bot: ALERT: fallback-attribution spike for partner:key-112 in last 10m (67 events).

sec: any UI that shows customer SA/subject must be RBAC gated to org owners/admins. audit log must record attribution_reason and whether exchange result updated billing. no org-id leaks.

serena: also propose a backfill job to recompute attribution for last 72h for high-impact keys and mark suggested corrections in telemetry (do not auto-bill). rate-limit the backfill and surface diffs in console.

console-team: planning: add a new admin toggle "Show effective identity & attribution" in request logs; columns: req_id, ts, attributed_entity, effective_identity (collapsed), attribution_reason, exchange_latency_ms, trace_link. add filter for attribution_reason==fallback.

amy: rollout plan: 1) quick metrics + probe to detect pending-exchange patterns (48h), 2) router wait behind flag (canary to 5% of traffic) next week, 3) console admin toggle in 2 weeks, 4) backfill research after metrics stable.

ben: i'll draft PR for router change and feature flag. serena will add trace probe + metric. console-team will mock UI prototype and sec will sign off on RBAC/audit.

sec: will review audit schema and retention. one more: ensure console toggle defaults to off and collapsed, and only org admins can expand the effective_identity.

amy: thanks all. i'll open customer comms draft and tag affected accounts. ping me on PR reviews. :thumbsup:
